name: aios
description: AI Management System — Azure Static Web App

scripts.dev: npm run --prefix api build && concurrently -k -n func,vite -c green,cyan "npm run --prefix api start" "vite --port 5173"
scripts.dev:full: npm run --prefix api build && concurrently -k -n vite,api,swa -c cyan,green,yellow "vite --port 5173" "npm run --prefix api watch" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && swa start http://localhost:5173 --api-location api"
